# Assessments

The course is letter graded. Category weights are TBD. Three things are required of
everyone.

| Requirement | What it means | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly attendance | Be in the room each week. Absence policy TBD. | TBD |
| Peer feedback | Give and receive structured feedback with the other leaders during the roundtable. | TBD |
| AI proficiency | Demonstrate working proficiency with AI tools. Requires a paid Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus subscription, $20 per month, maintained all semester. Bar and evidence TBD. | TBD |

Because student employees are paid for their leadership work, class sessions and
class-specific assignments are not billable hours. Keep the two separate on your timesheet.
